lines.en: My long legs stride over the brush
I walk slowly with my head high
My neck stretches and settles
I walk on the forest litter

lines.zh: 我细长的影子拖在地上
lines.en: My thin shadow trails behind
Each step reaches further
I step around a fallen tree
I dip my head to the ground
I pass between the trunks
I stop, then go on
I cross the stream on stones
I stand tall and still
My ears move both ways
I lower my head to sniff the grass
Fine lines cross my hide
I tip my head to one side

lines.zh: 风穿过我的长脖子，今天很安静。
lines.en: The wind runs through my long neck; today is quiet.

lines.zh: 我站在高处，把这个群系看个遍。
lines.en: I stand up high and look over the whole biome.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我只是在发呆。
lines.en: Don't come too close, I'm only staring into space.

lines.zh: 我两格多高，低头才看见你。
lines.en: Two blocks tall, I must look down.
You are far shorter than me
My eyes turn slowly to you
I take your scent
I lift a forefoot and set it down

lines.zh: 两格三宽的我，路就这么窄。
lines.en: Two blocks wide, the path is that narrow.
I do not mind you being here
Your movements are quick

lines.zh: 长脖子一缩，我退到树后。
lines.en: My long neck pulls back as I retreat behind a tree.
I pull my neck back
I lower my head to the wound

lines.zh: 我细长的身子晃了晃，差点栽倒。
lines.en: My thin body sways and nearly topples.
I shake my long neck and steady myself.
I shift my weight back
I let out a long breath
All four legs still hold me
I am not leaving yet

lines.zh: 你举着的果子，我低头闻了闻。
lines.en: I lower my head to sniff the fruit you hold up.
I do not much eat that
That is not one mouthful
I will leave it after all
I lift a foot and step back

lines.zh: 你手里那东西，闻着有点意思。
lines.en: That thing in your hand smells a little interesting.

lines.zh: 我不抢，但我想凑近看看。
lines.en: I won't snatch it, but I want a closer look.

lines.zh: 若你放下它，我就当没看见。
lines.en: If you put it down, I'll pretend I saw nothing.
You are the one thrown back
I look down to see if you are hurt
My legs are sturdier than they look

lines.zh: 你撞到我的长腿，我侧开一步。
lines.en: You hit my long leg, and I step aside.
I barely felt that
Do not shove my knee
I settle onto my feet
You'd bump into me? You dare?
There are others of my kind here

lines.zh: 我偶尔听见远处的叫声
lines.en: I sometimes hear a call far off
We each keep our own path
Her neck is slimmer than mine

lines.zh: 我们一起吃过一片叶子
lines.en: We once shared a patch of leaves
Such things take time
I do not fight over such things
She walked into the trees
A whole grove lies between us
I go back to grazing
I lower my head and take it
This thing is far too small
I set it down and look
I sniff twice and let go
I nudge it with a hoof
I dip my head and lift it
I walk slowly away

lines.zh: 捡吧，反正我不缺这一口。
lines.en: Go on and pick it up; I have plenty to eat anyway.
You came into my path
I stop and look at you
I straighten my neck
What did you just do

lines.zh: 你进了我的长腿够得到的范围。
lines.en: You've stepped within reach of my long legs.
Stop your hands first
You made the first move
This one will not be light

lines.zh: 我把细长的头低到你胸口的高度。
lines.en: I lower my slender head to your chest height.

lines.zh: 我长腿迈得很慢，但没停。
lines.en: My long legs move slowly but never stop.
You went behind that tree
My stride covers more ground than yours
You go left, I cut right
I look toward you
You are standing on my shadow
No hurry, long legs help
You are inside my circle
It is dangerous when I lower my head
I wait for your strength to fail
You hear my hooves
One more step and I am there
You cannot get past my legs
I arc my long neck down
Hiding in these trees will not help
I slowly close you in
I have this whole stretch in view
Do not go toward the stream
I never have to hurry
My hoof comes down
My head strikes your chest
My long leg kicks out
I lower my head and butt you
My horn grazes your shoulder
My foot lands beside you
You are knocked backwards
That carried my weight
You block, and your arms go numb
I step back and come on
My knee finds you
My forefoot is up again
You are thrown aside
That was not my full strength
I look down at you
I put a leg across your path
I shoulder you out of the way
My hoof catches your knee
I lower my head to watch you fall

lines.zh: 树影里立起一个高影子
lines.en: A tall shape rises in the trees

lines.zh: 我慢慢从林子里走出来
lines.en: I walk slowly out of the woods
My neck comes out first
Hooves come closer from far off

lines.zh: 我从林子里迈出来，踩断枯枝。
lines.en: I step from the trees, snapping a dead branch.
I halt at the edge of the clearing
My head clears the branches
I lower my head and see you
The woods go quiet for a moment
I come up from the stream
My steps rustle the leaves
Fire singes the hair on my legs
I land and my legs give
Water closes over my shoulders
The blast turns me sideways
An arrow sticks in my long leg
Magic curls around my neck
A day without a mouthful of leaves

lines.zh: 雷电顺着我的脊背下来
lines.en: Lightning runs down my spine

lines.zh: 我这么长的腿也抓不住
lines.en: Even legs this long find nothing
